project.name: command
project.description: The chain-of-command domain: General, SquadLeader, and Soldier as roles (interfaces), plus the Order/Objective value types passed between them. This is the "interface package" of the project - deliberately framework- and Netty-free so that both an implementation package (command-ai) and a consumer package (bot) can depend on it without depending on each other. Do not add Spring or Netty dependencies here; that dependency direction is enforced by the ArchUnit rules in the app module.
